cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Thank you for finding reunion venues. My garden will make everyone feel at home. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Such thoughtful planning. I'll put a gazebo in the garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation as a backup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're a lifesaver. Cancel it and put the deposit toward my gazebo; then we're all committed.

mechanism: A warmly leads reunion planning and takes on practical work to keep B cooperative while absorbing each alternative into A garden plan until no backup remains.
confusable: Unlike genuine open consultation, each appreciated contribution removes a meaningful choice; borrowed authority accommodates burdens without restoring those choices.
comparison: Venue backup and gazebo deposit differ from packing task choice and progressively sole responsibility for plates.
seedUse: Use D69-a hall shelter/gazebo/backup/deposit with S02-b retaining cooperation through real workload concessions.
